title: Tanese banned-form list
description: Japanese and Tamil particles, case endings, verbal endings and honorifics that a Tanese morpheme may not equal. The machine-readable side of LOCKED decision 3.

form.description: The source-language form in a lowercase ASCII transliteration, compared to Tanese morphemes by whole-form equality.

unspellable.description: True when the form cannot be written in the Tanese romanization at all, so no Tanese morpheme could collide with it. Not a free claim: a check asserts this field agrees with the phonotactic validator for every entry.
